content: 1:1-3 In Yisas wonou yurau igoarar qamb inmaribigorei
Ye Pol, Qenu wonou uyes ye Yisas munon wuriubersiau tari eng wonou sarau ebeter eng ye bo imusi eb qamb yemaribigorei.

Yonou munon banam Sostenes nob ombur namanimun gumat an Qenu munon yurau Korin igoumon end gaiar qamb bigotoroun. Munon inubersiau tari Yisas anseara an munon qoregen wonou yurau igoarar qamb anmaribigorei. An anmaribig ne munon ginam gugum gor wuri ininou Munon Aib inubersiau tari Yisas unumut qamb igour eng gor soro wurimaribigorei. End wuri in nob garisi ininou Munon Aib.
End Qenu ininou Tain ten eng Munon inubersiau tari Yisas nob wurinou uyes anubersiari oau mein igoarar.
1:4-9 Pol Qenut uber qamb qamarei
End Qenu Yisast anmusier end ye qenen anit igub wo nob uber qamb igoum.
Yisas wot an erogori igo ne gor an saubinat igo wonou qob werei wes-wes at qamarau eng mom imbig igoumon eng.
Munon inubersiau tari wonou qob aninob qamamin eng an mom iruges big igub oabigumon end mom nonoguret igoumon.
End ne see an mom ininou Munon inubersiau tari eng dibeneriner eng mom qoat igoumon. Ende ebet igoumon end Igomurur qau mi banam ar andab igo mi ger me anwogub igo.
End at igoumon end munon inubersiau tari Yisas eng mom annonogursia ten igama isi qen sasam eng yariba. Ende obounon eng ininou Munon Barai Yisas deriner qen end an mindigar qob ger igama me ginerei.
An Qenu wonou wau Yisas inubersiau tari eng nob tenori mom igoarar qamb anmaribigorei. End Qenu wo mi ebeib qamb qamar eng me biistinerei, ebet qas wegiba.
1:10-17 Yisas yurau purab tau-tau isumirei

End ininou Munon Barai inubersiau tari Yisas wo gab-gab ne ye an irun wab qemeribam eng: An mom erogori igo qob qeemben gari qamb igoarar. Bo purab tau-tau isub ende me abar. An erogori igo ne qi qenunget misir gari big igoarar.
See igoumon eng an musub me igoumon. End Kloe wonou yurau qei yar ende yonob qamarari igub aninob quraum.
An gari-gari der ete at qamb igoumon: Ger der, “Ye Pol wonou yurau,” ne ger bo der, “Ye Apolos wonou yurau.” Ne ger bo, “Ye Pita wonou yurau.” A ger bo, “Ye munon inubersiau tari eng wonou yurau.”

Ende at qamb igoumon eng maigas? Mai, munon inubersiau tari eng wo mai, munon ende bubur qereiamorei qiyo? Ne gor ye Pol, ye mai, nam tenoribig yanamari umb anmusiamei qiyo? Mai ye unumut yat anmaragansiamirei qiyo?
An munon yurau end munon ombur-ombur Krispus Gaius nob wurimaragansiamei, ger ue. End ye Qenut uber qamb igoum.
End munon ger yonou unumut munon ombur eng wurimaragansiamei qamb me wurit qomorunor.
Io, ye Stepanas wonou yurau gor wurimaragansiem eng nasi wogub munon qei me wurimaragansiau qurumei. Mai, munon qei gor wurimaragansiamei qiyo ye sir ue.

Munon inubersiau tari ye yiimuriamor eng munon wurimaragansi qamb me yiimurimau. Wo ye wonou qob uber eng wurinob qem qamb yiimuriamorei. End ye munon qei qob gugum mom imbig wogub qamb igour gas ende me qemerinei. Ye ende ebein eng Yisas nam tenori big waramir end qob suein eng yonou qob eng qeretutnob me yigisunorei.
1:18-31 Qenu wonou qiribiten eng Yisas boopuri tarubarei igo

Munon qei wurinou mi dui mom umub qamb eng Yisas nam tenori big waramir qob eng soagen ende qamb igour. A in munon Qenu inmusiarei qamb wot oabig igoun eng, Yisas nam tenori big waramir eng Qenu wonou mi wes ebeter eng imbig igoun.

End Qenu qob ete at qamarei: “Ye munon wurinou qoyam imbi-imbi wurisierine bo nasiorubour. Ne gor munon buk qebebi wanunger ne mom qoyamet igour eng wurisiningoar wegibam.” Qenu qob qoan ende qamb gumatemir eng gab ye ete qemerin:

End ne munon qoyam aib eng mai oboubour? Ne munon qei qoyametorub qamb buk irou wanunger igour eng wuri mai oboubour? Ne munon gugum qob at agunub igour eng gor mai oboubour? Munon yurau eng Qenu wuriseara sig mom qanganget uburubour.

Munon ai qent wurinou uyes Qenu imbiguboun qamb bur youn iru isub igamari Qenu ibagar eng misue eng ibag wonou qoyam imbi-imbi end werei wurit taisiarei. Munon wonou qob soagen eng in dibes qamb igoun eng igub munon inubersiau tari end wot oabigari qo qubeiamorei.
Yuda wuri Qenu wonomi wes eng aba mag qurt gub qamb ibitiri igurei. A Grik wuri qoyam eng mom imbigub qamb ibitiri ende at igurei.
Ego in Munon inubersiau tari eng nam tenori big waramari umor end qob suab qirune Yuda wuri inmerimotar igour. A Grik wuri qob eng igub qob soagen qamb igour.
Ego in Yuda qiyo Grik nob garisi Qenu wonou inmaribigor eng in ete imbigun: Yisas mi wes ebeter eng Qenu wonou qiribiten eng nob qoyam eng nob ba dibesiarei, ende imbigun.
Qenu wo mi song ebeiner eng munangit qoyam eng wotanamimba. Ne Qenu wo mein buriner eng sig gagam munangit wurinou eng gor wuritanamimba.

Io, qoan an maigas igamari Qenu anseara wonou yurau buraman end misir igar. Qoan an munon qei ag e mi imbig qeretutnob mi abau eng musub me imbig igamau, ne an qei qiribiten me igamau, ne qei unum diban me igamau. An ende igamari Qenu anseara wonou yurau buramanei.

Munangit qomon soagen qamb igour eng Qenu wo munon qoyam eng wurinob qamara qininingubour. Ne gor, mi ag et munangit mi qeretutnob ue qamb igour eng Qenu wo bo aba mi qeretutnob see igour eng bumaimba.
Qenu wo mi unum diban ue eng nob munangit mi siningot igour eng nob ba ubersiarei. Mi qoan me igamau eng ba mi qoan igoar eng aba uburerei.
End ne see munon ger Qenu menmant me qen biginer.
Qenu an Munon inubersiau tari eng nob garisi igoarar qamb anmaribigorei. Wo munon qoyam ininou gigit igo. Yisas wot in munon qoregen igoruboun. Wonou inmusuor end in munon qoregen qib igoun.
End ne Qenu qob ete igo eng in toat igoarar qamb qenungar igo: “Munon ger mismisir gab eng munon Aibt gari mismisiriner.” Qoan Qenu qob ende at qamb gumatemirei.
